Set against the opulent yet rigid backdrop of high-society St. Petersburg, this sweeping realist epic explores a passionate, illicit romance that defies the stifling marriage norms of 19th-century Russia. As a deeply committed noblewoman risks her social standing and family for a charismatic military officer, the crushing weight of public hypocrisy pushes them toward an inevitable and devastating tragedy. This monumental tale of desire and moral collapse exposes the cruel machinery of an aristocracy incapable of forgiving true freedom.
